visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a blue and white striped shirt over a white T-shirt, speaks directly to the camera in what appears to be a bathroom setting with light-colored tiles. (2) He holds up a mint green toothpaste tube that is completely flattened to show how little product is left inside. (3) He uses a pair of scissors to cut the toothpaste tube in half horizontally, then shows the remaining paste inside to the camera while smiling. (4) He picks up a dark brown pump bottle, shakes it to show it is nearly empty, and then adds water to it from a tap. (5) An animated segment appears with several cut-outs of his head floating over a cartoon angel body against a pink and white background. (6) The scene shifts to a shopping mall environment where he holds a white charging cable with a frayed, exposed wire. (7) He walks through an ADAM elements retail store, placing the old cable into a cardboard box featuring a cartoon pig and looking at new chargers. (8) He showcases various electronic products, including a yellow power bank and magnetic charging cables, in a bright retail environment with logos visible. (9) He poses next to a large yellow cartoon mascot and shows a promotional box and a small fan. (10) The video ends with a montage of the products and the creator smiling while holding a fan and a power bank.
